scenes.title: Clear air keeps the sensor dark
A useful warning for smouldering fires

vo.text: This smoke detector can sound the alarm before flames are visible.
vo.speak: This smoke detector can sound the alarm before flames are visible.

vo.text: Inside this photoelectric detector, smoke reveals itself by scattering a hidden beam of light.
vo.speak: Inside this photoelectric detector, smoke reveals itself by scattering a hidden beam of light.

vo.text: In clear air, an LED sends light across a dark chamber.
vo.speak: In clear air, an LED sends light across a dark chamber.

vo.text: The light sensor sits off to one side, so the straight beam normally misses it.
vo.speak: The light sensor sits off to one side, so the straight beam normally misses it.

vo.text: When smoke enters, tiny particles scatter some of that light toward the sensor.
vo.speak: When smoke enters, tiny particles scatter some of that light toward the sensor.

vo.text: The sensor's signal rises, and the electronics trigger the loud alarm.
vo.speak: The sensor's signal rises, and the electronics trigger the loud alarm.

vo.text: It is especially useful for slow, smouldering fires that produce visible smoke.
vo.speak: It is especially useful for slow, smouldering fires that produce visible smoke.

vo.text: So the detector does not smell smoke; it notices smoke scattering light into its sensor.
vo.speak: So the detector does not smell smoke; it notices smoke scattering light into its sensor.
